dialect: PostgreSQL 18 grammar (libpg_query has no dialect option)
parser_family: PostgreSQL grammar: libpg_query extracts the PostgreSQL 18 server raw parser (bison gram.c, flex scan.c, parser.c); shared by pg_query_go, Rust pg_query, pglast and the libpg-query WASM npm packages
oracle: The replay prints the JSON parse tree that pg_query_parse returns; summarize.py reads SelectStmt, InsertStmt, RangeVar, JoinExpr, FuncCall and A_Const nodes from it, and run-control requires the hand-written oracle summary.
api: pg_query_parse(local NUL-terminated SQL text) -> PgQueryParseResult with the parse tree serialized as JSON; pg_query_free_parse_result
coverage: LLVM source coverage of pinned libpg_query 18.1.0 sources reached by pg_query_parse (PostgreSQL grammar, scanner, parse-tree JSON output); bison/flex #line directives removed so lines map to the pinned gram.c and scan.c
scope: One SQL statement from local bytes parsed by pg_query_parse with the PostgreSQL 18 grammar; valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls only, each matching the hand-written oracle summary. PL/pgSQL, deparse, fingerprint and protobuf outputs are untested.
